item.title: Taking the course Fundamentals of cybersecurity
item.description:
🖥️ Course about the cybersecurity

For the past few days, I completed the course on the fundamentals of cybersecurity and I will share some of my experience about the course. Firstly, this course is about basic of cybersecurity which covers a lot of concept about well… CYBERSECURITY!! and some stuff about networking, website and computer protection and etc, it maybe a bit much, but rest assured, this course is also completely for beginner who are interested in cybersecurity or want to know a bit about such field.

🛜 Network security

The first section of the course, focuses on how the internet works, which covered such as

  • Basic networks protocols - TCP/IP, HTTP, and others,
  • Network personalization for how the settings affect security,
  • The risk and protection of the Wireless Wi-Fi networks

Additionally, it introduced some usages and concept of Tor browser and other anonymization methods. Personally, the Tor module was especially interesting — it really showed how online anonymity works in practice.

📱 PC/Phone protection

Next up, the second section, which covered about personal digital hygiene and the protection of personal device such as

  • Disk encryption
  • The idea of strong passwords and password managers.
  • The concept of Phishing
  • Viruses with real-world examples and protection methods.
  • Messenger security

🔗 Cryptography in practice

The final part of the course, the most interesting and challenging. In this section will covered the important parts such as

  • Introduction to cryptography (history, algorithms, why it’s important)
  • Blockchain (no hype, just clear example)

As well as the topic about digital signatures and verify authenticity, Electronic payments and transaction security.

🏁 Overall

This is a really great course for introduction to the cybersecurity, since it covered a lot of concept about such field, plus give some ideas about protection and how some systems work in general.

Unfortunately, This course doesn’t provide any certificate of completion (sad…😞), but we received something more important… knowledges… (unless you need the certificate for something else…🤨). Anyway, this’s it for now. Thank you for reading the post!

item.title: Taking the course introduction to Linux
item.description:
🐧 Course about Linux

In this week, I completed the course on basic operating system Linux. And I will share my experience about the course.

Start,

This course is completely from beginner, who are trying to use Linux, or learning how to operating system Linux works. Firstly, we started with the installation of Linux with step by step explanation

💻 Interface and Command Line

After the installation of Linux, the first thing we will get to know is the graphic interface, which honestly, it look alike like Window and MacOS

In the course, we will be working with command Line. Working with command line can be quite overwhelming for beginners. But in the course, this will be covered as well, along with other things such as:

  • Navigating through files
  • How to run program
  • Using complex commands

🌐 Work with remote server

The next stage will be working with remote server, where the course will cover the topic like:

  • Connect to server via SSH
  • Running program remotely
  • Getting result from remote server to local computer

⚙️ Advance topis

In the final part of the course, we will cover some unique topics such as

  • Writing bash scripts
  • Learning / Mastering text editor Vim
  • Creating Graphic interface

The course also provides practical tasks for testing the knowledge of the participates, especially the part of writing program script, since it requires to think and approve the task logically.

🎓 Certificate

After complete the course, you will receive the certificate of completion (which you can show it off to your friends 😆 ).

🏁 Overall

this is a good course for learning the basic of Linux, and also getting the general idea on how to work with operating system Linux works.

item.title: Neon
item.description:
What is Neon?

Neon is the 3D game that I have been working for quite some times now, Neon is a pixel-based indie cyberpunk game. In a world where the city has been captured by the AI system, the player will have to learn how to survive. Gloomy atmosphere, stylish neons, and the struggle of a man with machines

🔥 Features:

  • Moody pixel-art visuals with a cyberpunk soul.

  • Tactical survival gameplay - think fast or get deleted 💀 .

  • A haunting synthwave soundtrack that pulses with the city’s heartbeat.

The game is still under development since I only work on it in my free time.

item.title: Qis
item.description:
Qis is a custom bash shell I’m building in C. I’m striving to make it as flexible and user-friendly as possible, both for everyday users and seamless system interaction. A mini-tool for those who crave a little more control.

This is a project that I have in mind for a long time, I will probably work on it during free time
